install.command: bash -e -o pipefail -c 'curl -fsSL https://bun.com/install | bash -s bun-v1.3.14; curl -fsSL https://mise.run | MISE_VERSION=v2026.7.11 MISE_INSTALL_SKIP_IF_EXISTS=1 sh; "$HOME/.local/bin/mise" trust; "$HOME/.local/bin/mise" install; "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts'
